# routeros_system_watchdog (Resource)


## Example Usage
```terraform
resource "routeros_system_watchdog" "settings" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `auto_send_supout` (Boolean) After the support output file is automatically generated, it can be sent by email.
- `automatic_supout` (Boolean) When software failure happens, a file named "autosupout.rif" is generated automatically.
- `ping_start_after_boot` (String)
- `ping_timeout` (String)
- `send_email_from` (String) E-mail address to send the support output file from.
- `send_email_to` (String) E-mail address to send the support output file to.
- `send_smtp_server` (String) SMTP server address to send the support output file through.
- `watch_address` (String) The system will reboot in case 6 sequential pings to the given IP address will fail.
- `watchdog_timer` (Boolean) Reboot if system is unresponsive for a minute.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import
Import is supported using the following syntax:
```shell
terraform import routeros_system_watchdog.settings .
```
